Card Q&A.q: Can I activate this card's inherited effect even if my opponent's Digimon and the Digimon that has this card in its digivolution cards are deleted at the same timing?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may return 1 Digimon card with [Tyrannomon] in its name or the [Dinosaur] trait from your trash to the hand.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, gain 1 memory.
